title: That's a Wrap — Thank You, Cosmos Conf 2026!
content:
And just like that, Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 is in the books. A huge thank you to everyone who tuned in today — and to the incredible speakers, the production crew, and the partners who made the show happen.

A special shout-out to our community who showed up in the YouTube live chat and kept the energy going all day long. You make this event what it is.

title: The Countdown to Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Starts Now
content: April 28 is coming fast. We've published a full preview of what to expect — from cutting-edge AI agent architectures to production-hardened data modeling and everything in between. Read the preview. Also, want in on the action early? The #nosql channel on the Azure Open Source Discord is live — connect with the community, talk sessions, and get hyped with us.

title: Meet the Speakers for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026!
content: We're proud to announce our speaker lineup for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026, presented in partnership with AMD! Thanks to AMD's support, we've expanded the show to a full 5 hours — 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM PDT. This year's roster brings together world-class speakers from across the community — covering AI and RAG architectures, vector search, MCP servers, security, data modeling, distributed systems, and more. Meet the speakers and see who's joining us on April 28, 2026.

title: Welcome AMD — Our Headline Partner for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026!
content: We're excited to welcome AMD as a partner for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026! Thank you, AMD, for your support of the Azure Cosmos DB community. Register now to join us on April 28, 2026.
